Round 6 complete. One candidate was created, evaluated once, and recorded.

## What was analyzed (Stage 1)

**Parent selected:** `b51ec0b` (panel-budget-draws, average 0.5722) — the deepest node.

I replayed the eight pooled draws per example from the four pre-panel runs and found the panel is already sitting on top of what its draws contain: mode 0.3000 vs oracle 0.3333 (USPTO), 0.6000 vs 0.6667 (LawBench), 0.8400 vs 0.8800 (Symptom2Disease). So no aggregation rule can add more than +0.03/+0.07/+0.04 — the miss is in the draws. The retrieval path (the lineage's own recommended lever) was the untouched one: a hash of the question picked a random third of LawBench's memory (32–72 of 200 examples), while 48% of the parent's USPTO calls were the agent re-reading a memory file whose answer content the tool had already returned.

## Modification (Stage 2)

`solver/tools/retrieval.py` now hands over the whole demonstration set, ordered by closeness to the question, with the only remaining cut sized from the model's own context window (`0.25 × context_window`); config is threaded through `tools/__init__.py`/`agent.py`; the skill no longer tells the agent to go search the memory. Panel, grounding and vote untouched.

## Result — expected effect not achieved

`{"USPTO": 0.25, "Symptom2Disease": 0.89, "LawBench": 0.57, "average": 0.57, "status": "ok"}` against the parent's 0.5722.

The mechanism ran as designed (USPTO file-wandering gone: read_file 365→34, glob 124→2; context 265,372→37,876 chars; calls 1306→705; losses 3→0), but the average is flat: S2D +0.04 and LawBench +0.02 against USPTO −0.067.

The decisive finding, recorded in the note: **on LawBench the change never reached the model** — 99/100 samples had the 105,318-character retrieval evicted by the agent's own middleware (20,000-token tool-result limit) into `/large_tool_results/`, leaving a ten-line preview and 71 `read_file` calls. A lottery split of the 50 val questions confirms the consequence: the 15 questions whose gold the full memory newly demonstrates scored 16/30 before and 16/30 after, refuting the coverage reading of the earlier correlation.

Committed as `40218c3` on branch `retrieval-whole-memory` (tree `6baad5e0`, matching the run dir), with the evolution note attached under `refs/notes/evolution`; working tree clean and source byte-identical before and after the run.
